answers.q1: Maven, via the Maven Wrapper (Java 17+ required). Install dependencies with: ./mvnw dependency:resolve (Gradle is also present, via ./gradlew, but CI uses Maven).
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B validate (runs the spring-javaformat validate goal and the nohttp checkstyle check, both bound to the validate phase; CI's ./mvnw -B verify includes these). The Gradle equivalent is ./gradlew checkstyleMain checkstyleTest checkstyleNohttp checkFormatMain checkFormatTest, but CI does not run it.
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated from src/main/scss/*.scss by the Maven 'css' profile (./mvnw package -P css), so edit the .scss sources and regenerate instead. src/main/resources/static/resources/fonts/* are vendored third-party webfonts (Montserrat, Varela Round). The Maven and Gradle wrapper files (mvnw, .mvn/wrapper/, gradlew, gradle/wrapper/) are also vendored tooling. No target/ or build/ output is checked in.
